item.title: Connor Storrie Makes Surprise ‘SNL’ Cameo to Introduce Olivia Rodrigo’s New Song: Watch
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: "Welcome back to 'Trending on Billboard'! I've got some exciting news to share with you. This past Saturday, May 2nd, Olivia Rodrigo took the stage on Saturday Night Live, and she had some special introducers. The one that caught everyone off guard was Connor Storrie, star of Heated Rivalry, who made a surprise appearance to introduce Rodrigo's new song 'Begged'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Storrie, who hosted SNL back in February, looked sharp in an all-denim outfit and received a warm welcome from the live audience. He only appeared to introduce Rodrigo's performance, but it was definitely a noteworthy moment. 'Begged' is part of Rodrigo's upcoming album, 'You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love', which drops on June 12th."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Rodrigo also hosted the episode, and earlier in the night, she performed her lead single 'Drop Dead' with an intro by the legendary Debbie Harry of Blondie. 'Drop Dead' has already become Rodrigo's fourth No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, and it's clear she's on a roll. This marks Rodrigo's third appearance on SNL, but her first time hosting. Make sure to check out the video of Storrie's surprise appearance and Rodrigo's performances – we'll have the links in our show notes."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for today's 'Trending on Billboard'. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
